proof_scope: Read actual PPTX and live viewer payload; check research/reuse text, timing, ordering and handout links. No visual approval, runtime qualification, measured talk duration or paper reproduction.

cases.name: reject-export-with-missing-research-text
command: cd .. && python3 -c 'import tempfile,zipfile,subprocess; from pathlib import Path; src=Path("/mnt/storage12tb/oai-trial/native-pitchdeck/oai-trial-current.pptx"); t=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); bad=Path(t.name)/"bad.pptx"; a=zipfile.ZipFile(src); b=zipfile.ZipFile(bad,"w"); [b.writestr(n,a.read(n).replace(b"dogpile",b"REMOVED") if n=="ppt/slides/slide7.xml" else a.read(n)) for n in a.namelist()]; b.close(); p=subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/verify_research_presentation.py",str(bad)],capture_output=True,text=True); assert p.returncode!=0 and "AssertionError" in p.stderr,p; print("PASS: missing research text refused")'
